notes.subject: wokim olsem pota i wokim
notes.rationale: יצר em i wokim olsem pota i folem klem — Tok Pisin i nidim planti tok long wanpela tok Hibru

notes.subject: תנשני
notes.rationale: Niphal: 'yu bai no lusim mi' (YLT/JPS) o 'ol i no ken lusim yu long mi' (KJV/ASV) — namba tu tok i stap insait long Tok Pisin Hibru

notes.subject: Tingim ol dispela samting
notes.rationale: Maket bilong ol man i rit — singaut bilong tingim

notes.subject: long Yakov na Yisrael
notes.rationale: Tok i go stret long Yakov na Yisrael

translation: Tingim ol dispela samting, Yakov na Yisrael, long wanem yu em wokman bilong mi; mi wokim yu olsem pota i wokim; yu wokman bilong mi; yu, Yisrael, no ken lusim mi.

tokens.gloss: mi wokim yu olsem pota i wokim
